These files are served locally so the editor works without a CDN.

|---|---|---|---|
| CodeMirror | 5.65.18 | MIT | https://github.com/codemirror/codemirror5 |
| js-yaml | 4.1.0 | MIT | https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml |
| jsdiff | 5.2.0 | BSD-3-Clause | https://github.com/kpdecker/jsdiff |

License texts are available in the respective upstream repositories.
